# nginxproxymanager_user (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nginxproxymanager_user" "user" {
  name     = "My User"
  nickname = "Cool Nickname"
  email    = "user@domain.com"
  roles    = ["admin"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) Email of the user, used for logging in. Must be lowercase, as NPM lowercases it when updating a user.
- `name` (String) Username of the user.
- `nickname` (String) Nickname for the user.

### Optional

- `is_disabled` (Boolean) Whether the user is disabled or not.
- `roles` (List of String) A list of roles that the user has.

### Read-Only

- `avatar` (String) URL to the avatar for the user.
- `id` (String) ID of the user.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import nginxproxymanager_user 10
```
